entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original Minecraft RPG ability inventory sprite. Attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE from Monumenta, not an edit target. Match its economical pixel clusters, restrained localized light, recognizable object, and chunky low-resolution shading. Output a square icon with the artwork occupying about 80% of the canvas. Draw as an actual 32 by 32 logical pixel sprite enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels, no detail smaller than one logical pixel, no antialiasing. Plain very dark charcoal background. No frame, no letters, no UI, no labels, no watermark. Must read when downscaled to 16x16. NOT glossy mobile-game illustration, NOT thin geometric symbol, NOT elaborate background. Subject: a single coherent broad steel sword angled from lower left hilt to upper right tip, with a short curved ochre slash streak behind the blade, suggesting a heavy physical cut. The attached reference shows how simply to depict this. Make our sword silhouette original: broad straight blade, readable short crossguard, dark leather grip. Silver gray and pale blue three-tone metal, dark brown grip, muted warm ochre motion. Slash is secondary, not a giant flame crescent. Keep hilt, guard and blade properly connected.
